title: "Type ... is not loaded or supported" (TypeException) in tf2_ros Python: PoseStamped and do_transform_pose, measured
excerpt: Why buffer.transform() raised TypeException for PoseStamped until tf2_geometry_msgs was imported, why except TransformException didn't catch it, which five types the import registers, and the do_transform_pose AttributeError. Measured in rclpy on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
